reference: curl 8.x file:// handling as documented by curl(1) and RFC 8089: the candidate and the reference curl read the same private relative fixture through an absolute file:// URL.
coverage: file:// reads, -o, localhost host form, percent decoding, errors 37 and 3.

G36: -w/--write-out variables (%{size_download}, %{content_type}, %{url_effective}, %{redirect_url}, %{num_redirects}, %{size_header}, ...), %header{}, @FILE, %{onerror}, -w output on -f failures, and --fail-with-body, against GNU curl on a loopback peer.

Pass 9 G136: -i, -e, --url, --create-dirs, -K, --resolve, -R, -z, -n/--netrc, --noproxy, --proto, --stderr, accepted -g/-N/-4/-q, curl: (N) transfer errors and curl's option diagnostics, against curl on a loopback peer.
exclusions: -I and -C on file:// URLs, directory listings.

cases.purpose: file:///PATH and file://localhost/PATH return the file's bytes; -o writes them; percent escapes decode (guest compatibility pass 1).
cases.script:
printf 'hi\n' > f
printf 'sp\n' > 'a b'
curl -s "file://$PWD/f"
curl -s "file://localhost$PWD/f"
curl -s "file://$PWD/a%20b"
curl -s -o out "file://$PWD/f"; cat out

cases.purpose: A missing file is error 37 and another host is error 3; -s suppresses the messages.
cases.script:
curl -s "file://$PWD/missing" || echo rc=$?
curl -s "file://otherhost/x" || echo rc=$?

cases.purpose: G36: -w expands the common transfer variables, %header{NAME} and %%, and reports an unknown variable on stderr, as GNU curl does.
cases.script:
cat > srv.py <<'PY2'
import socket
# Loopback peer for the -w cases: /200, /302 (to /200), /500; one request per connection.
s = socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 18090)); s.listen(8)
print('ready', flush=True)
while True:
    c, _ = s.accept(); c.settimeout(4)
    data = b''
    while b'\r\n\r\n' not in data:
        part = c.recv(4096)
        if not part: break
        data += part
    path = data.split(b' ')[1].decode() if data.count(b' ') else '/'
    if path == '/quit': c.close(); break
    code = {'/302': '302 Found', '/500': '500 Oops'}.get(path, '200 OK')
    extra = 'Location: /200\r\n' if path == '/302' else ''
    c.sendall(('HTTP/1.1 %s\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n%sContent-Length: 4\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nbody' % (code, extra)).encode())
    c.close()
s.close()
PY2
coproc SRV { /usr/bin/python3 srv.py; }
read -r -t 5 ready <&"${SRV[0]}"
U=http://127.0.0.1:18090
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}|%{response_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}|%{url_effective}|%{redirect_url}|%{num_redirects}|%{size_header}|%{method}|%{scheme}|%{http_version}|%{exitcode}|%{num_headers}|%header{location}|100%%\n' $U/302
curl -s -L -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}|%{url_effective}|%{redirect_url}|%{num_redirects}|%{size_header}|%{url}\n' $U/302
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '[%{definitely_unknown}]\n' $U/200 2>&1
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST -d abc -w '%{method} %{size_upload}\n' $U/200
curl -s $U/quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$SRV_PID" || true
rm -f srv.py

cases.purpose: Guest pass 4 G61: --unix-socket PATH sends the HTTP request over a unix-domain socket (Host and request target still from the URL) and %{remote_ip} names the socket; a missing socket is exit 7 and an empty PATH a usage error (exit 2).
cases.script:
trap 'rm -f srv.py sock' EXIT
cat > srv.py <<'PY2'
import socket, sys
# Unix-domain HTTP peer: echo the request line and Host header in the body.
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); s.bind(sys.argv[1]); s.listen(4)
print('ready', flush=True)
for _ in range(int(sys.argv[2])):
    c, _ = s.accept(); c.settimeout(4)
    data = b''
    while b'\r\n\r\n' not in data:
        part = c.recv(4096)
        if not part: break
        data += part
    lines = data.split(b'\r\n')
    host = [l for l in lines if l.lower().startswith(b'host:')]
    body = lines[0] + b'|' + (host[0] if host else b'') + b'\n'
    c.sendall(b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' % len(body) + body)
    c.close()
PY2
coproc SRV { /usr/bin/python3 srv.py sock 2; }
read -r -t 5 ready <&"${SRV[0]}"
curl -s --unix-socket sock 'http://example.test/p?q=1' -w '[%{http_code} %{remote_ip} %{remote_port}]\n'
curl -s --unix-socket sock http://h:8080/x
wait "$SRV_PID" || true
curl -s --unix-socket missing http://x/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl -s --unix-socket '' http://x/ 2>/dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
rm -f srv.py sock

cases.purpose: G136: -i/--include writes the response head before the body; -e/--referer, --url, --create-dirs, -K/--config (quoted url =, bare long names, comments, short options), --resolve HOST:PORT:ADDR, -R/--remote-time, and the accepted -g -N -4 -q and --noproxy '*' (which bypasses -x) behave as curl does against a loopback peer.
cases.script:
cat > srv.py <<'PY2'
import socket
# Loopback peer: echoes the request line and the Referer, If-Modified-Since,
# If-Unmodified-Since and Authorization headers; fixed Last-Modified.
s = socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 18191)); s.listen(8)
print('ready', flush=True)
while True:
    c, _ = s.accept(); c.settimeout(4)
    data = b''
    while b'\r\n\r\n' not in data:
        part = c.recv(4096)
        if not part: break
        data += part
    lines = data.split(b'\r\n')
    path = lines[0].split(b' ')[1].decode() if lines[0].count(b' ') else '/'
    if path == '/quit': c.close(); break
    keep = [l for l in lines[1:] if l.split(b':')[0].lower() in (b'referer', b'if-modified-since', b'if-unmodified-since', b'authorization')]
    body = b'\n'.join([lines[0]] + keep) + b'\n'
    c.sendall(b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nLast-Modified: Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' % len(body) + body)
    c.close()
s.close()
PY2
coproc SRV { /usr/bin/python3 srv.py; }
read -r -t 5 ready <&"${SRV[0]}"
U=http://127.0.0.1:18191
curl -s -i $U/include
curl -s -e http://referer.example/page $U/referer
curl -s --url $U/url
curl -s --create-dirs -o d1/d2/out $U/dirs && cat d1/d2/out
printf 'url = "%s/config"\nsilent\n# comment\n-e http://from-config/\n' "$U" > cfg
curl -K cfg
curl -s --resolve name.invalid:18191:127.0.0.1 http://name.invalid:18191/resolve
curl -s -g -N -4 -q --noproxy '*' -x http://127.0.0.1:1 $U/flags
curl -s -R -o rt $U/remote-time && stat -c %Y rt
curl -s $U/quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$SRV_PID" || true
rm -f srv.py

    body = b'\n'.join([lines[0]] + keep) + b'\n'
    c.sendall(b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nLast-Modified: Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' % len(body) + body)

PY2
coproc SRV { /usr/bin/python3 srv.py; }
read -r -t 5 ready <&"${SRV[0]}"
U=http://127.0.0.1:18191
curl -s -z 'Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT' $U/same; echo "rc=$?"
curl -s -z 'Tue, 20 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT' $U/older
curl -s -z '-Tue, 20 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT' $U/unmodified; echo "rc=$?"
curl -s -z '-Thu, 22 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT' $U/unmodified-later
touch -d '2015-10-20 00:00:00 UTC' stamp
curl -s -z stamp $U/file-stamp
printf 'machine 127.0.0.1 login alice password s3cret\n' > .netrc
HOME=$PWD curl -s -n $U/netrc
HOME=$PWD curl -s --netrc -u bob:pw $U/netrc-user
curl -s $U/quit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$SRV_PID" || true
rm -f srv.py

cases.purpose: G136: transfer errors are curl's 'curl: (N) ...' lines (7 for a refused connection), --stderr - sends them to stdout, --proto disables a protocol with error 1, a bad --resolve entry is error 49, an unreadable -K file is 26, and option errors are 'curl: option X: is unknown/requires parameter/is badly used here' with curl's hint (exit 2).
cases.script:
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:1/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS --stderr - http://127.0.0.1:1/ 2>/dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS --proto =https http://127.0.0.1:1/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS --proto -all,+https http://127.0.0.1:1/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS --resolve bad http://127.0.0.1:1/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS -K no-such-config http://127.0.0.1:1/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS --limit-rate x http://127.0.0.1:1/ || echo "rc=$?"
curl --bogus-option || echo "rc=$?"
curl -o || echo "rc=$?"
curl -sS -e || echo "rc=$?"
